The '''Administrative Levels''' were a collection of levels in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The [[Exex]] was located in the Administrative Levels, as was the [[Parliament of Guilds]]. Cloud City's main hospital, [[Cloud City Central]], was located on the Administrative Levels. [[Figg Avenue]] was located just off the Administrative Levels.
